title: Audit log entry
description: An append-only record of a privileged action. Written server-side (Functions or Rules), never mutated, and never authored by clients. Deliberately has no updatable lifecycle.

target.description: Record the action affected, when applicable.

source.description: Execution context that produced the entry.

before.description: Optional snapshot of relevant fields before the action.

after.description: Optional snapshot of relevant fields after the action.

metadata.description: Additional non-sensitive context (request id, reason code, etc.).
